plugins.name: brainstorming-tools
plugins.description: Skills for working with superpowers implementation plans — optimizing-writing-plans runs an independent second-pass review-and-fix on a freshly written plan.

plugins.name: pr-tools
plugins.description: Skills for cleaning up pull requests — simplify-pr marks formatter/lint and import-path-only files as Viewed so reviewers see only the substantive diffs.

plugins.name: gcloud-tools
plugins.description: Skills that wrap the gcloud CLI to analyze Google Cloud operational and security signals — analyze-cloud-armor finds Cloud Armor WAF false positives, and analyze-error-reporting produces a weekly Cloud Error Reporting digest of new and spiking error groups.
